title: Uruguayan Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Uruguay, made with tender beef and a hint of herbal flavors.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan beef
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with good marbling for tender results.

ingredients.name: Herbal broth
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought broth or make your own using herbs like thyme and rosemary.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Adds a rich depth of flavor to the stew.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Adds natural sweetness to the stew.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Thickens the stew and provides a satisfying bite.

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the browned beef back to the pot, along with the herbal broth and soy sauce.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
